rule.title: Alimony is deductible only under an agreement entered into on or before December 31, 2018

citation.wording: If you made payments to or for your spouse or former spouse under a divorce or separation agreement entered into on or before December 31, 2018, you may be able to take this deduction.

rule.open_point: Lines 19b and 19c (the recipient's SSN, the agreement's month and year) are entries, not figures.
